preconditions: Pinned EveJS revision and overlay hashes verified
Disposable, attested copies of GameStore SQLite, Rust market database, wallets, inventory and durable journals
Two authorized client accounts and independently authenticated characters
No production evejs-data volume mounted writable
Explicit human approval for destructive faults on cloned data only
cases: Inventory and corporate wallet SQL commit succeeds, account invalidators run, both clients read new balances
Crash before GameStore BEGIN: no item or wallet changes
Crash after native item debit but before wallet debit: all rows roll back
Crash immediately after GameStore COMMIT and before client ACK: identical claim ID reconciles without second payout
Crash after native reward write but before journal terminal phase: HOLD_MANUAL until authoritative receipt inspected
WAL synchronous FULL cannot be established: reject before any native economic debit
Dirty persistence worker/outbox row cannot overwrite a later atomic commit after restart
Rust PENDING sell order with no native escrow: no visible sell liquidity or duplicate release
Rust FILLED order without native GameStore receipt: HOLD_MANUAL, not reissue payment
Native GameStore receipt exists but Rust fill not finalized: reconcile same immutable claim only
Two Rust claim keys reference same fillID: stop settlement
Two open market orders claim the same native escrow itemID: stop settlement
NPC cargo and market escrow both reference same native itemID: stop settlement
Courier collateral and reward escrow after partial failure: no multiple owner claims
Manufacturing material consumption and paid job receipt across restart: one job per material debit
Finished manufacturing product receipt refers to a destroyed or missing item: require manual recovery
Player-to-player market transfer with tax and fees conserves exact integer cents
Planetary commodities route/launch transfer across restart conserves exact native quantities
Independent two-character wallet and item state preserved after forced disconnect/reconnect
Repeat request after ambiguous native RPC acknowledgment does not regenerate ISK, items, LP or SP
